title: ToolCompleted
description: A tool invocation ended, from the `tool_result` the SDK reports on a `user` message.

status.description: `denied` is not a failure of the tool: it is a human having said no, and the UI reads the two differently.

summary.description: A short result for the timeline. The full output is the transcript's job, not this event's.

parentToolUseId.description: Set when this comes from a subagent: the `toolUseId` of the `Task` that opened it. Absent on the main conversation.

taskId.description: The task of the list a `TaskCreate` made or a `TaskUpdate` changed — taken from the tool's structured result live, and from its result in the history. Absent for every other tool. The `summary` is the CLI's text, cut, and never carries it reliably (plan 08, B-20).
